grammar_focus: 一般过去时讲“发生了什么”,重点在不规则动词的过去式(find→found、dig→dug、stand→stood、begin→began、come→came、feel→felt、wear→wore、sweep→swept…),外加易混词 happen(to be)碰巧、美式 story(楼层,与'故事'同形;英式 storey)、worship(崇拜)↔warship(军舰)(原创承载 NCE3 L3 考点·美国考古队复原古代女神像)
scene: 几年前,一支美国考古队在海边一处岩石岬角上勘探一座古城遗址。那座古城当年一定很繁荣,因为它曾有很高的文明水平。考古学家发现了宽阔的街道,街道下面挖出了旧排水系统的陶管。常有三层高的石屋沿路而立。在一座残破神殿最神圣的房间里,工人们找到了许多小雕像的碎片。每尊都是一位女神,当年都上过彩。考古队把碎片带回实验室,开始慢慢拼合。有一尊格外费解:身体来自很古老的遗物,头却碰巧来自晚得多的古典时代——想必古代有人捡到这颗头,认出它的价值,小心保存了下来。等到终于复原,考古队惊讶地发现:这位女神看上去像个非常现代的女子。她约三英尺高,双手叉在臀部,穿一条拖地长裙。尽管年代久远,她却真的很优雅。可到目前为止,谁也查不出她的身份。

grammar_card.title: 讲“发生了什么”:一般过去时 & 不规则动词过去式
grammar_card.intro: 讲过去发生、已经完成的事,用一般过去时。规则动词直接加 -ed(explore→explored、enjoy→enjoyed);但很多常用动词是不规则的,必须一个个记牢:find→found、dig→dug、stand→stood、begin→began、come→came、feel→felt、wear→wore、sweep→swept、keep→kept。另外记三组易混:①happen to be = 碰巧是(By chance);②美语里“楼层”拼 story(复数 stories),和“故事”同形,英式才拼 storey;③worship(崇拜、礼拜)别和 warship(军舰)搞混。

rows: they found the fragments; they dug up pipes
the work began; the head came from later remains
they felt amazed; she wore a long skirt
the head happened to be much older

specialRules.rule: 不规则动词过去式没有规律,只能背:begin→began(不是 beginned)、come→came(不是 comed)、feel→felt(不是 feeled)。注意别把过去分词当过去式:begun/worn 是过去分词。
美语里“楼层”和“故事”都拼 story(a three-story house / an old story);英式把“楼层”拼作 storey 以区分。本课已按美语写 stories。
worship /ˈwɜːrʃɪp/ 崇拜、礼拜;warship /ˈwɔːrʃɪp/ 军舰。拼写、意思都不同,别弄混。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What did the American team find in the sacred room?

passage: A few years ago, an American team explored an ancient site on a rocky promontory high above the sea. The old city there must have been prosperous, for it once enjoyed a high level of civilization. The archaeologists found wide streets, and beneath them they dug up clay pipes from an old drainage system. Houses, often three stories high, stood along the road. In the most sacred room of a ruined temple, once a busy place of worship, the workers found the fragments of many small statues. Each one showed a goddess, and each had once been painted in bright colors. The team carried the pieces back to the lab and began the slow work of putting them together. One statue puzzled everyone. Its body came from very old remains, but its head happened to be from a much later, classical time. Someone in ancient days must have found the head, recognized its value, and kept it with great care. When the archaeologists finally reconstructed the figure, they felt amazed. The goddess looked like a very modern woman. She stood about three feet high, her hands rested on her hips, and she wore a full-length skirt that swept the floor. Despite her great age, she was truly graceful. So far, however, no one has been able to discover her identity.
